text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A series of deadly attacks jolt Algiers: four bombs exploded on Sunday in the city and the neighbouring Bordj el Kiffan town, killing at least six people and wounding more than 70 others.
- Algerian expatriates in France to start voting in the parliamentary elections on June 2, two days ahead of the polling across Algeria.
- Political parties step up preparations for the poll campaign with backdrop of violence flare-up.
- First film in Tamazight Berber language showed in Algiers.
- Algeria's main iron and steel firm negotiate workers' lay-off with local labour union.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf visits Germany in a diplomatic drive to fit Algeria into the Mediterranean economic context.
- The Transitional National Council meets to vote retirement law.
